# Chisel workbench for Open NPU design

[![Documentation Status](https://readthedocs.org/projects/chisel-opennpu/badge/?version=latest)](https://chisel-opennpu.readthedocs.io/en/latest/?badge=latest)

Docs: https://chisel-opennpu.readthedocs.io

This is a chisel workbench designed for someone who like docker containers and vscode dev container plugin.

## Highlights

- **RISC-V-style 32-bit ISA** with 13 opcode families (LD/ST, MMA, VALU_*),
  R/I/S formats, full decoder (`isa/instrDecoder.scala`) and Scala assembler
  (`isa/NpuAssembler.scala`).
- **K×K systolic MMALU** that natively supports **?×K streaming reduction**
  — one continuous `ctrl.keep = true` feed accumulates over arbitrary M ≥ K
  cycles, with cumulative K×K partial sums emitted at every K-cycle boundary.
  See [docs/implementations/SystolicArray.md — M×K Streaming Reduction](https://chisel-opennpu.readthedocs.io/en/latest/implementations/SystolicArray/#mk-streaming-reduction)
  and the verifying spec
  [`src/test/scala/alu/mma/MMALUStreamReduceSpec.scala`](src/test/scala/alu/mma/MMALUStreamReduceSpec.scala).
- **K-lane VALU** with FP32 / BF16 / BF8 conversions, fused multiply-add,
  programmable two-bank LUT (`vlut` / `vsetlut`), and horizontal reductions.
- **Multi-width register file** with VX (K×N), VE (K×2N), VR (K×4N) views
  sharing the same physical storage — INT8 inputs, INT32/FP32 accumulators in
  one bank.
- **End-to-end post-MMA quantization pipeline** verified bit-accurately against
  a Scala `java.lang.Float` reference (`NCoreBackendQuantSpec`,
  `NCoreBackendGemmSoftmaxSpec`).
- **FPGA reference platform**: Kintex-7 `xc7k480tffg1156-2` with PCIe Gen2×8 +
  dual DDR3 + K=32 MMALU at 200 MHz fabric / 250 MHz NPU. See
  [docs/implementations/FPGA_XC7K480T.md](docs/implementations/FPGA_XC7K480T.md).

## Usage

```bash
# Build docker image for chisel dev:
make image
# Create & Run the image as a container
make container
# Test chisel design
make test
# Build verilog design from chisel
make build
# Build systemc
make build-sc
# Build docs, visit http://localhost:8000 to see the documentation
make docs
```

Then you can use [vscode dev container plugin](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ms-vscode-remote.remote-containers) to connect this container. Happy coding (for chip)

## Project Structure
```
├── build.sbt           // project top level build
├── docker
│   └── dockerfile      // build env docker file
├── docs                // documentation
├── ip                  // IP integration with different EDAs
│   └── xilinx          // xilinx vivado
├── Makefile            // top level make file
├── mkdocs.yml          // readthedocs yaml
├── project             // scala project settings
├── README.md
├── src                 // chisel source
│   ├── main            // chisel design
│   └── test            // chisel tests
└── top.sv              // generated top system verilog
```

## Reference

1. [Chisel Matmul](https://github.com/kazutomo/Chisel-MatMul)
2. [Patmos VLIW processor](https://github.com/t-crest/patmos/tree/master/hardware)

## Useful Links

1. [Chisel project template](https://github.com/freechipsproject/chisel-template/tree/main#chisel-project-template)
2. [Chisel Bootcamp](https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/freechipsproject/chisel-bootcamp/master)
3. [ChiselTest](https://github.com/ucb-bar/chiseltest)
4. [Chisel Cheatsheet](https://github.com/freechipsproject/chisel-cheatsheet/releases/latest/download/chisel_cheatsheet.pdf)
5. [Chisel API Docs](https://javadoc.io/doc/org.chipsalliance/chisel_2.13/5.0.0/index.html)

1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	Repo-specific guidance for OpenCode. Read `README.md` first for the user-facing overview; this file covers what an agent would otherwise guess wrong.
4	
5	## Toolchain
6	
7	- Chisel 6.7.0, Scala 2.13.12, sbt 1.9.7 (`build.sbt`, `project/build.properties`).
8	- Requires firtool 1.62.1, verilator v5.036, SystemC 3.0.1. All provided by the `fangruil/chisel-dev:{amd64,arm64}` Docker image (`docker/dockerfile`).
9	- Bare-host `sbt` generally will not work unless firtool is on `PATH` and Chisel 6.7.0 is `publishLocal`'d. Prefer Docker for every command.
10	
11	## Commands
12	
13	All `make` targets shell out to `docker run -v $PWD:/workspace fangruil/chisel-dev:<arch> ...`. `ARCH` comes from `uname -m`; `x86_64` is remapped to `amd64` inside `Makefile`.
14	
15	- `make image` — build the dev image (`make image-amd64` / `image-arm64`).
16	- `make container` — interactive shell in the image with repo mounted at `/workspace`.
17	- `make test` — runs `sbt test` in the image.
18	- `make build` — runs `sbt run`, which elaborates `top.Main` and writes `top.sv` at repo root.
19	- `make build-sc` — verilator SystemC backend. Note: the target reads `top.v` but `top.Main` emits `top.sv` (`Makefile:29,34` vs `src/main/scala/top/top.scala:18`). Rename or patch before invoking.
20	- `make docs` — `pip3 install -r docs/requirements.txt && mkdocs serve` on the host (not in Docker).
21	- `make clean` — removes `target`, `*.v`, `*.anno.json`. Does **not** delete the checked-in `top.sv` (~17 MB).
22	- `make clean-cache` — wipes `.cache/` (the mounted Coursier cache; see env below).
23	
24	### Single-test shortcut
25	
26	- `tool/test-specific-spec.sh <fully.qualified.Spec>` → `sbt "testOnly <Spec>"` in the image.
27	- `tool/test-all.sh` → same as `make test`.
28	
29	## Parameter notation (authoritative)
30	
31	These three symbols are used everywhere in the ISA, VALU, register-file, and backend code.
32	Confusing them is the primary source of errors in this codebase.
33	
34	| Symbol | Meaning | Default (test) | Default (top) |
35	|:---:|:---|:---:|:---:|
36	| **`N`** (spoken: **N(bits)**) | Base lane width in bits for a VX register. Equals MMALU's `nbits`. Always `N(bits)` in prose to avoid confusion. | 8 | 8 |
37	| **`L`** | Number of base VX registers. Must be divisible by 4 for VE/VR aliasing. | 32 | 32 |
38	| **`K`** | SIMD lane count per register. At the backend boundary, `K == MMALU.n` (the array side). | 8 | 64 |
39	
40	Register-class aliasing over a shared physical byte array (`L × K × N/8` bytes total):
41	
42	| Class | Count | Lane width | Aliases |
43	|:---|:---:|:---|:---|
44	| VX[0..L-1] | 32 | N bits | native |
45	| VE[0..L/2-1] | 16 | 2N bits | `VE[i] ≡ VX[2i] ∥ VX[2i+1]` |
46	| VR[0..L/4-1] | 8 | 4N bits | `VR[i] ≡ VX[4i..4i+3]` |

- `make image` — build the dev image (`make image-amd64` / `image-arm64`).
- `make container` — interactive shell in the image with repo mounted at `/workspace`.
- `make test` — runs `sbt test` in the image.
- `make build` — runs `sbt run`, which elaborates `top.Main` and writes `top.sv` at repo root.

- `make docs` — `pip3 install -r docs/requirements.txt && mkdocs serve` on the host (not in Docker).
- `make clean` — removes `target`, `*.v`, `*.anno.json`. Does **not** delete the checked-in `top.sv` (~17 MB).

2	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
3	//  SimpleBackend.scala — NPU backend: InstrDecoder + MultiWidthRF + MMALU + VALU
4	//
5	//  Parameters:
6	//    K    — SIMD lane count per register = MMALU array side (default 8).
7	//           At the top level, K = 64 to match MMALU(new MMPE(), 64, 8, 32).
8	//    N    — base lane width in bits / N(bits) (default 8).
9	//    L    — number of VX base registers (default 32, must be div-by-4).
10	//
11	//  MMALU mapping: MMALU.n (array side) == K; MMALU.nbits == N.
12	//  This is the backend boundary alignment constraint. Both must be equal.
13	//
14	//  Register file (MultiWidthRegisterBlock):
15	//    VX[0..L-1]     K × N bits     INT8 / BF8 results, MMALU narrow inputs
16	//    VE[0..L/2-1]   K × 2N bits    INT16 / BF16 results
17	//    VR[0..L/4-1]   K × 4N bits    INT32 / FP32 results; MMALU accumulator direct write
18	//
19	//  Port assignments:
20	//    VX read:  port 0 = MMALU in_a; port 1 = VALU in_a_vx
21	//    VX read:  port 2 = VALU in_b_vx; port 3 = external read
22	//    VE read:  port 0 = VALU in_a_ve; port 1 = VALU in_b_ve
23	//    VR read:  port 0 = VALU in_a_vr + MMALU in_b; port 1 = VALU in_b_vr + in_c_vr
24	//    VX write: port 0 = VALU narrow out; port 1 = external write
25	//    VE write: port 0 = VALU VE out
26	//    VR write: port 0 = VALU VR out; port 1 = MMALU accumulator direct (INT32, no truncation)
27	//
28	//  Instruction decode: 32-bit word → InstrDecoder → DecodedMicroOp.
29	//  All dispatch is based on the decoded family + VecOp.
30	//
31	//  Write-back timing: VALU has a 1-cycle output register.
32	//  The backend keeps the decoded op active for 2 cycles (issue + write-back).
33	//  A production frontend should use a 1-cycle pipeline stall or forwarding.

111	  io.illegal_out   := decoder.io.illegal
112	  val dec = decoder.io.decoded
113	
114	  // ==========================================================================
115	  // Multi-width register file
116	  // ==========================================================================
117	  val rf = Module(new MultiWidthRegisterBlock(L, K, N,
118	    vx_rd = 4, vx_wr = 2, ve_rd = 2, ve_wr = 1, vr_rd = 2, vr_wr = 2))
119	
120	  // ---- VX reads ----
121	  rf.io.vx_r_addr(0) := io.mma_a_addr    // MMALU A
122	  rf.io.vx_r_addr(1) := io.vx_a_addr     // VALU in_a_vx
123	  rf.io.vx_r_addr(2) := io.vx_b_addr     // VALU in_b_vx
124	  rf.io.vx_r_addr(3) := io.ext_rd_addr   // external
125	  io.ext_rd_data      := rf.io.vx_r_data(3)
126	
127	  // ---- VE reads ----
128	  rf.io.ve_r_addr(0) := io.ve_a_addr
129	  rf.io.ve_r_addr(1) := io.ve_b_addr
130	
131	  // ---- VR reads ----
132	  rf.io.vr_r_addr(0) := io.vr_a_addr
133	  rf.io.vr_r_addr(1) := io.vr_b_addr
134	  io.vr_rd_data       := rf.io.vr_r_data(0)
135	
136	  // Drive the external read port of the RF (separate from vx_r_addr)
137	  rf.io.ext_r_addr := io.ext_rd_addr
138	
139	  // ---- Default: all write ports disabled ----
140	  rf.io.vx_w_en  := VecInit(Seq.fill(2)(false.B))
141	  rf.io.ve_w_en  := VecInit(Seq.fill(1)(false.B))
142	  rf.io.vr_w_en  := VecInit(Seq.fill(2)(false.B))
143	  rf.io.vx_w_addr := VecInit(Seq.fill(2)(0.U(VX_ADDR.W)))
144	  rf.io.ve_w_addr := VecInit(Seq.fill(1)(0.U(VE_ADDR.W)))
145	  rf.io.vr_w_addr := VecInit(Seq.fill(2)(0.U(VR_ADDR.W)))
146	  for (p <- 0 until 2) for (lane <- 0 until K) rf.io.vx_w_data(p)(lane) := 0.U
147	  for (p <- 0 until 1) for (lane <- 0 until K) rf.io.ve_w_data(p)(lane) := 0.U
148	  for (p <- 0 until 2) for (lane <- 0 until K) rf.io.vr_w_data(p)(lane) := 0.U
149	
150	  // ---- External write ----
151	  rf.io.ext_w_en   := io.ext_wr_en
152	  rf.io.ext_w_addr := io.ext_wr_addr
153	  rf.io.ext_w_data := io.ext_wr_data
154	
155	  // ==========================================================================
156	  // MMALU (systolic array; n = K lanes, nbits = N)
157	  // ==========================================================================
158	  val mmalu = Module(new MMALU(new MMPE(N), K, N, N4))
159	  mmalu.io.in_a := VecInit(rf.io.vx_r_data(0).map(_.asSInt))
160	  // MMALU in_b taken from VX (same layout as in_a, different addr)
161	  rf.io.vx_r_addr(0) := io.mma_a_addr  // already assigned above; in_b via separate VX port

164	  // For simplicity in tests, use the same vx_r_data(3) for MMALU B (driven by mma_b_addr).

167	  mmalu.io.in_accum := VecInit(Seq.fill(K)(0.S(N4.W)))
168	
169	  // MMALU control from decoded instruction
170	  mmalu.io.ctrl.keep      := dec.mma_keep
171	  mmalu.io.ctrl.use_accum := false.B
172	  mmalu.io.ctrl.busy      := (dec.family === OpFamily.MMA)
173	
174	  // MMALU write-back directly to VR (port 1) — NO precision truncation
175	  // mmalu.io.out is Vec(K, SInt(N4.W)) = Vec(K, SInt(32.W)) for N=8

178	    rf.io.vr_w_addr(1) := io.mma_out_addr

182	  }
183	
184	  // ==========================================================================
185	  // VALU
186	  // ==========================================================================
187	  val valu = Module(new VALU(K, N))
188	
189	  // Connect inputs from RF
190	  for (lane <- 0 until K) {
191	    valu.io.in_a_vx(lane) := rf.io.vx_r_data(1)(lane)
192	    valu.io.in_b_vx(lane) := rf.io.vx_r_data(2)(lane)
193	    valu.io.in_a_ve(lane) := rf.io.ve_r_data(0)(lane)
194	    valu.io.in_b_ve(lane) := rf.io.ve_r_data(1)(lane)
195	    valu.io.in_a_vr(lane) := rf.io.vr_r_data(0)(lane)
196	    valu.io.in_b_vr(lane) := rf.io.vr_r_data(1)(lane)
197	    valu.io.in_c_vr(lane) := rf.io.vr_r_data(1)(lane)  // C re-uses B port for now
198	  }
199	
200	  // Drive VALU ctrl from decoded bundle
201	  valu.io.ctrl := dec.valu
202	
203	  // Determine if this is a VALU family
204	  val isVALU = dec.family === OpFamily.VALU_ARITH  ||
205	               dec.family === OpFamily.VALU_LOGIC   ||
206	               dec.family === OpFamily.VALU_REDUCE  ||
207	               dec.family === OpFamily.VALU_LUT     ||
208	               dec.family === OpFamily.VALU_CVT     ||
209	               dec.family === OpFamily.VALU_BCAST   ||
210	               dec.family === OpFamily.VALU_FP      ||
211	               dec.family === OpFamily.VALU_FP_FMA  ||
212	               dec.family === OpFamily.VALU_MOV
213	
214	  // VALU write-back (port 0 for each class)
215	  when (isVALU) {
216	    // VX write-back.
217	    // isReduceToVR ops (vsum, vrmax, vrmin) encode their *input* class in regCls
218	    // (e.g. vsum.vx has regCls=VX so the VALU selects the VX reduction path).
219	    // That would accidentally assert vx_w_en and clobber vx_out_addr — suppress it.
220	    // isSetLut ops (vsetlut) write only to VALU-internal bank registers;
221	    // all RF write ports must be suppressed.
222	    rf.io.vx_w_en(0)   := ((dec.valu.regCls === W.VX) || isNarrowCvtOut(dec.valu.op)) &&
223	                           !isReduceToVR(dec.valu.op) &&
224	                           !isSetLut(dec.valu.op)
225	    rf.io.vx_w_addr(0) := io.vx_out_addr
226	    for (lane <- 0 until K) rf.io.vx_w_data(0)(lane) := valu.io.out_vx(lane)
227	
228	    // VE write-back
229	    rf.io.ve_w_en(0)   := dec.valu.regCls === W.VE
230	    rf.io.ve_w_addr(0) := io.ve_out_addr
231	    for (lane <- 0 until K) rf.io.ve_w_data(0)(lane) := valu.io.out_ve(lane)
232	
233	    // VR write-back (FP/INT32, wide conversion results, and horizontal reductions).
234	    // vsetlut has regCls=VR but must NOT write the RF — suppress it.
235	    rf.io.vr_w_en(0)   := ((dec.valu.regCls === W.VR) || isWideCvtOut(dec.valu.op) ||
236	                            isReduceToVR(dec.valu.op)) &&
237	                           !isSetLut(dec.valu.op)
238	    rf.io.vr_w_addr(0) := io.vr_out_addr
239	    for (lane <- 0 until K) rf.io.vr_w_data(0)(lane) := valu.io.out_vr(lane)
240	  }
241	
242	  // ==========================================================================
243	  // Helpers: determine output register class for conversion and reduce ops
244	  // ==========================================================================
245	  def isNarrowCvtOut(op: VecOp.Type): Bool = {
246	    op === VecOp.vcvt_s8_s32 ||  // s8 sign-extend → VX slice
247	    op === VecOp.vcvt_f32_s8     // FP32 → INT8 narrow
248	    // vcvt_s8_f32 = INT8→FP32: wide output → VR, NOT narrow
249	  }
250	
251	  def isWideCvtOut(op: VecOp.Type): Bool = {
252	    op === VecOp.vcvt_s32_f32  ||  // s32→f32: wide
253	    op === VecOp.vcvt_s8_f32   ||  // s8→f32: wide
254	    op === VecOp.vcvt_f32_s32  ||
255	    op === VecOp.vcvt_s32_s8   ||
256	    op === VecOp.vcvt_f32_bf8  ||
257	    op === VecOp.vcvt_bf8_f32  ||
258	    op === VecOp.vcvt_f32_bf16 ||
259	    op === VecOp.vcvt_bf16_f32 ||
260	    op === VecOp.vcvt_s16_s32  ||
261	    op === VecOp.vcvt_s32_s16
262	  }
263	
264	  /**
265	   * vsetlut writes only to VALU-internal LUT bank registers.
266	   * All register-file write ports must be suppressed for this op.
267	   */
268	  def isSetLut(op: VecOp.Type): Bool = op === VecOp.vsetlut
269	
270	  /**
271	   * Horizontal reduce ops (vsum, vrmax, vrmin) always produce a VR-width result
272	   * broadcast across all K lanes, regardless of the regCls field in the instruction.
273	   * The VALU unconditionally drives out_vr for these ops; the backend must enable
274	   * the VR write port to store the result in the register file.
275	   *
276	   * Root cause: the ISA encodes reduce ops with the *input* register class in
277	   * funct7[1:0] (e.g. vsum.vx uses regCls=VX to select the VX reduction path),
278	   * but the output is always VR-width.  The backend's regCls===VR guard therefore
279	   * misses these ops when issued on VX or VE inputs.
280	   */
281	  def isReduceToVR(op: VecOp.Type): Bool = {
282	    op === VecOp.vsum  ||
283	    op === VecOp.vrmax ||
284	    op === VecOp.vrmin
285	  }
286	}

// See README.md for license details
package alu.mma
import isa.micro_op._
import alu.pe._

import chisel3.util._
import chisel3._

/**
 * This is a general Matrix Multiplication ALU design
 * You can always implement your own PE module here.
 *
 * Timing note (2026-07-30):
 *   The critical path at 200 MHz ran from SystolicArray2D horizontal
 *   registers (reg_h) through 13 logic levels (8×CARRY4 + 5×LUT) into
 *   the PE multiply-accumulate chain, causing WNS = -0.151 ns.
 *   Fix: pipeline registers were inserted between the systolic array
 *   outputs and the PE inputs (pipe_a, pipe_b, pipe_ctrl), and between
 *   the ControlUnit and DataCollector (pipe_dat_clct, pipe_use_accum).
 *   This adds 1 cycle to the MMALU latency (3n-1 instead of 3n-2)
 *   but breaks the long combinatorial path into two 6-7 level segments.
 */
 class MMALU[T <: BasePE](pe_gen: => BasePE, val n: Int = 8, val nbits: Int = 8, val accum_nbits: Int = 32) extends Module {
    val io = IO(new Bundle {
        val in_a        = Input(Vec(n, SInt(nbits.W)))
        val in_b        = Input(Vec(n, SInt(nbits.W)))
        val in_accum    = Input(Vec(n, SInt(accum_nbits.W)))
        val ctrl        = Input(new NCoreMMALUCtrlBundle())
        val out         = Output(Vec(n, SInt(accum_nbits.W)))
        val clct        = Output(Bool())
    })

    // Create n x n pe blocks
    val pe_io = VecInit(Seq.fill(n * n) {Module(pe_gen).io})
    val dfeed = Module(new sa.DataFeeder(n, nbits, accum_nbits))
    val dclct = Module(new sa.DataCollector(n, accum_nbits))
    dfeed.io.reg_a_in <> io.in_a
    dfeed.io.reg_b_in <> io.in_b
    dfeed.io.reg_accum_in <> io.in_accum

    // we use systolic array to pipeline the instructions
    // this will avoid bubble and inst complexity 
    // while simplifying design with higher efficiency
    val ctrl_array = Module(new cu.ControlUnit(n))
    ctrl_array.io.cbus_in := io.ctrl

    // Pipeline registers between SA→PE and CU→Collector to break
    // the long combinatorial path (reg_h → PE mul/acc) that caused
    // WNS = -0.151 ns at 200 MHz on xc7k480t (K=32).
    // These are single-cycle registered pipelines; the +1 latency
    // shift is consistent across data and control paths.
    val pipe_a       = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(n * n)(0.S(nbits.W))))
    val pipe_b       = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(n * n)(0.S(nbits.W))))
    val pipe_ctrl    = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(n * n)(0.U.asTypeOf(new NCoreMMALUCtrlBundle()))))
    val pipe_accum   = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(n)(0.S(accum_nbits.W))))
    val pipe_dat_clct = RegNext(false.B)
    val pipe_use_accum = RegNext(false.B)
    val pipe_clct    = RegNext(false.B)

    for (i <- 0 until n) {
        pipe_accum(i)           := dfeed.io.reg_accum_out(i)
        dclct.io.accum_in(i)    := pipe_accum(i)
    }
    dclct.io.dat_clct  := pipe_dat_clct
    dclct.io.use_accum := pipe_use_accum
    io.clct            := pipe_clct

    val sarray = Module(new sa.SystolicArray2D(n, nbits))
    sarray.io.vec_a := dfeed.io.reg_a_out
    sarray.io.vec_b := dfeed.io.reg_b_out

    io.out <> dclct.io.reg_out

    for (i <- 0 until n){
        for (j <- 0 until n) {
            pipe_a(n * i + j)    := sarray.io.out_a(n * i + j)
            pipe_b(n * i + j)    := sarray.io.out_b(n * i + j)
            pipe_ctrl(n * i + j) := ctrl_array.io.cbus_out(n * i + j)
            pe_io(n * i + j).in_a  := pipe_a(n * i + j)
            pe_io(n * i + j).in_b  := pipe_b(n * i + j)
            pe_io(n * i + j).ctrl  := pipe_ctrl(n * i + j)
            dclct.io.reg_in(n * i + j) <> pe_io(n * i + j).out
        }
    }

    pipe_dat_clct  := ctrl_array.io.cbus_dat_clct
    pipe_use_accum := ctrl_array.io.cbus_use_accum
    pipe_clct      := ctrl_array.io.clct
 }

3	//  instrFormat.scala — RISC-V-inspired 32-bit instruction word layout
4	//
5	//  Parameters used throughout the ISA:
6	//    N(bits) — base lane width (default 8).  Always spelled N(bits) in prose.
7	//    L       — number of base VX registers (default 32, divisible by 4).
8	//    K       — SIMD lane count per register (default 8 for tests, 64 at top).
9	//              Equals MMALU's array-side parameter n at the backend boundary.
10	//
11	//  Instruction formats (32-bit word):
12	//
13	//  R-type  [funct7(7) | rs2(5) | rs1(5) | funct3(3) | rd(5) | opcode(7)]
14	//  I-type  [    imm[11:0](12)  | rs1(5) | funct3(3) | rd(5) | opcode(7)]
15	//  S-type  [rs3(5)|rnd(2)| rs2(5) | rs1(5) | funct3(3) | rd(5) | opcode(7)]
16	//
17	//  funct7 attribute layout (R-type):
18	//    [1:0] width  : 00=VX (N bits)  01=VE (2N bits)  10=VR (4N bits)  11=reserved
19	//    [3:2] round  : 00=RNE  01=RTZ  10=floor  11=ceil
20	//    [4]   sat    : 0=wrap  1=saturate
21	//    [6:5] dtype  : 00=INT  01=FP   10=BF     11=reserved
22	//
23	//  vcvt (VALU_CVT family) uses funct7 differently:
24	//    [2:0] src format code  (see FmtCode enum)
25	//    [3]   saturate
26	//    [5:4] round mode
27	//    [6]   BF8 variant      0=E4M3  1=E5M2
28	//
29	//  funct3 meanings are family-specific; see instSetArch.scala.
30	//  rd, rs1, rs2 index VX[0..L-1].  VE uses rd[3:0]; VR uses rd[2:0].
31	// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

33	package isa
34

36	import chisel3.util._

39	// Bit-position constants (field boundaries in the 32-bit word)
40	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
41	object InstrBits {
42	  val OPCODE_LO  =  0;  val OPCODE_HI  =  6   // 7 bits
43	  val RD_LO      =  7;  val RD_HI      = 11   // 5 bits
44	  val FUNCT3_LO  = 12;  val FUNCT3_HI  = 14   // 3 bits
45	  val RS1_LO     = 15;  val RS1_HI     = 19   // 5 bits
46	  val RS2_LO     = 20;  val RS2_HI     = 24   // 5 bits
47	  val FUNCT7_LO  = 25;  val FUNCT7_HI  = 31   // 7 bits
48	
49	  // I-type immediate: bits[31:20]
50	  val IMM_I_LO   = 20;  val IMM_I_HI   = 31   // 12 bits (sign-extended)
51	
52	  // S-type (FMA): rs3 at [31:27], round at [26:25]
53	  val RS3_LO     = 27;  val RS3_HI     = 31   // 5 bits
54	  val RND_S_LO   = 25;  val RND_S_HI   = 26   // 2 bits
55	
56	  // funct7 attribute sub-fields
57	  val F7_WIDTH_LO = 0;  val F7_WIDTH_HI = 1   // [1:0] in funct7
58	  val F7_ROUND_LO = 2;  val F7_ROUND_HI = 3   // [3:2] in funct7
59	  val F7_SAT      = 4                          // [4]   in funct7
60	  val F7_DTYPE_LO = 5;  val F7_DTYPE_HI = 6   // [6:5] in funct7
61	
62	  // vcvt funct7 sub-fields
63	  val F7_CVT_SRC_LO = 0; val F7_CVT_SRC_HI = 2  // [2:0]
64	  val F7_CVT_SAT    = 3                           // [3]
65	  val F7_CVT_RND_LO = 4; val F7_CVT_RND_HI = 5  // [5:4]
66	  val F7_CVT_BF8    = 6                           // [6] BF8 variant
67	}
68	
69	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
70	// Width class: which register class the instruction operates on
71	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

"""ChiselNPU — high-level NPU facade.

Orchestrates a full MMALU compute cycle on top of XDMADevice + CtrlLite:

    stage A/B/ACCUM (native module knows the DDR addresses)
        → kick (ctrl_lite start)
        → wait for done
        → read OUT back

The Python side only ever moves buffers; every address lives in the
native module.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional

import numpy as np

from .backend import XDMADevice
from .ctrl import CtrlLite
from .errors import NPUError, NPUTimeoutError


class ChiselNPU:
    def __init__(
        self,
        dev: Optional[XDMADevice] = None,
        ctrl: Optional[CtrlLite] = None,
        timeout_s: float = 2.0,
    ):
        self.dev = dev if dev is not None else XDMADevice()
        self.ctrl = ctrl if ctrl is not None else CtrlLite(self.dev)
        self.timeout_s = timeout_s
        self._out_nbytes = self.dev.operand_size("OUT")

    # ── step helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def stage_operands(self, A, B, ACCUM) -> None:
        """Write A (int8[K]), B (int8[K]) and ACCUM (int32[K]) to DDR.

        Sizes are validated by the native module against the staging table.
        """
        self.dev.write_staged("A", A)
        self.dev.write_staged("B", B)
        self.dev.write_staged("ACCUM", ACCUM)

    def kick_and_wait(self, timeout_s: Optional[float] = None) -> None:
        """Kick the NPU FSM and block until done (raises on timeout)."""
        t = timeout_s if timeout_s is not None else self.timeout_s
        if self.ctrl.is_busy:
            raise NPUError("NPU FSM unexpectedly busy before kick")
        self.ctrl.kick()
        if not self.ctrl.wait_done(timeout_s=t):
            raise NPUTimeoutError(
                f"NPU did not assert done within {t} s "
                "(DMA master or MMALU stuck?)"
            )

    def collect_out(self, OUT: Optional[np.ndarray] = None) -> np.ndarray:
        """Read the OUT operand from DDR. Fills *OUT* if given, else allocates int32[K]."""
        if OUT is None:
            OUT = np.empty(self._out_nbytes // 4, dtype=np.int32)
        self.dev.read_staged("OUT", OUT)
        return OUT

    # ── whole cycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def mmalu(
        self,
        A,
        B,
        ACCUM,
        OUT: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
        timeout_s: Optional[float] = None,
    ) -> np.ndarray:
        """One MMALU cycle: stage → kick → wait done → read OUT.

        *A*, *B*: int8[K] buffers; *ACCUM*: int32[K] buffer (any buffer-like
        accepted). Returns the int32[K] result (into *OUT* if provided).

import glob
from typing import Optional, Union

import numpy as np

# Python Userspace Driver (`chisel_npu_py`)

## Overview

`chisel_npu_py` is the Python userspace driver for the NPU on the FPGA
verification platform. It sits on top of the Xilinx XDMA kernel driver and
speaks to the NPU through the same `ctrl_lite` + DMA-staging protocol as the
C tools (`reg_rw`, `dma_to_device`, `dma_from_device`), with a strict
**pybind11 boundary**: the C++ module owns every file descriptor, DDR
address, register offset and transfer; Python only moves buffers (numpy
arrays, bytes, bytearray, memoryview) and names staged operands. **No DDR
address or register offset ever appears on the Python side.**

Source: `drivers/chisel_npu_py/` — installed on the FPGA host at
`~/chisel_npu_py/` with a venv at `~/chisel_npu_py/.venv`.

```
tests (pytest, native on FPGA host)
   │
chisel_npu_py (Python: orchestration, bit protocol, injectable native)
   ├── ChiselNPU   — mmalu(A, B, ACCUM[, OUT]): stage → kick → wait → collect
   ├── CtrlLite    — start/done/busy bit protocol, wait_done
   ├── XDMADevice  — write_staged/read_staged/operand_size/ctrl_read/write
   └── _native.so  ── pybind11 C++ module ── owns: fds, DDR addresses,
                                          staging table, alignment, transfers
                              │
                     /dev/xdma0_* (xdma.ko kernel driver)
```

## The C++ boundary

The pybind11 module (`NativeXDMA`, in
`src/chisel_npu_py/native_src/native.cpp`) is the **single authority on
addresses**:

- DMA uses `pwrite`/`pread` with the file offset as the AXI address — the
  exact semantics of the vendor tools (`cdev_sgdma.c` passes `*pos` into
  `xdma_xfer_submit`). The C++ layer runs the full-transfer loop and
  validates every transfer internally (alignment, lengths, address window).
- Register access maps one page of `/dev/xdma0_bypass` (`bridge_mmap`) and
  reads/writes the ctrl_lite control word at a fixed offset.

input.rationale: chisel-npu 是一个用 Chisel 6.7.0 实现的开源 NPU,核心是 NCoreBackend(译码器 + 多宽度寄存器堆 + 脉动矩阵乘 MMALU + 向量 ALU VALU),上层有 RISC-V 风格 32 位 ISA,下层有 Kintex-7 FPGA 验证平台与 Python/Linux 用户态驱动。学习路线据此按"由外到内、由计算单元到系统集成、由 RTL 到平台"的顺序分三层组织:入门层(U1)先让读者跑通项目并掌握贯穿全局的 N/L/K 参数;进阶层(U2-U6)按数据流方向逐层拆解——先 ISA 指令接口,再控制/存储基础(Bundle+寄存器堆),再两个计算单元 MMALU 与 VALU,最后回到 NCoreBackend 看它们如何连线与分发;专家层(U7-U9)上升到端到端量化流水线、FPGA 平台与驱动、以及测试与 CI。单元划分对应物理边界(ISA / 存储 / 矩阵引擎 / 向量引擎 / 集成 / 流水线 / 平台 / 测试),每篇讲义只解决一个问题并附一个可在容器内验证的代码实践,依赖关系保证读者随时知道每个模块的前置知识来自哪里。

lectures.title: 全局参数 N/L/K 与寄存器类概念
lectures.topic: 讲清贯穿全代码的三个符号 N(bits)、L、K 的含义,以及 VX/VE/VR 三类寄存器在同一物理存储上的别名关系。
learning_goals: 准确说出 N(bits)、L、K 各自的含义与默认值
理解 K 在 backend 边界等于 MMALU 阵列边长 n 的约束
掌握 VX/VE/VR 三类寄存器的位数与别名关系
理解 L 必须被 4 整除的原因
lectures.practice_task: 假设 N=8、L=32、K=8,计算 VX/VE/VR 各自的寄存器数量、每寄存器位宽与总物理存储字节数,并在 instrFormat.scala 中找到编码 width 选择的 funct7 位段,写出 VE[i] 与 VR[i] 对应的 VX 别名下标公式。

lectures.title: 32 位指令编码格式 R/I/S
lectures.topic: 讲解 RISC-V 风格的三种指令格式及其在 32 位字中的位段定义。
learning_goals: 掌握 R/I/S 三种格式的字段布局与位段边界
理解 opcode/funct3/funct7/rd/rs1/rs2/rs3 的作用
能用 InstrBits 常量定位任意字段
理解 I 型立即数的符号扩展与 S 型 FMA 的 rs3/rnd 字段
lectures.practice_task: 给定一个 32 位指令字,手写提取 opcode、funct3、funct7、rd、rs1、rs2 的位运算表达式,并用 InstrBits 中的常量核对你的掩码与移位值是否一致。

lectures.title: opcode 家族与 funct3/funct7 属性
lectures.topic: 讲解 13 个 opcode 家族的分配、funct3 子操作划分与 funct7 属性编码(width/round/sat/dtype)。
learning_goals: 列出所有 opcode 家族及其编码值
理解 opcode 选家族、funct3 选子操作、funct7 带属性的分层设计
掌握 funct7 中 width/round/saturate/dtype 的位段
理解 vcvt 家族复用 funct7 的特殊编码
lectures.practice_task: 在 instSetArch.scala 中统计所有 opcode 家族,自制一张表记录每家族的 opcode 值、典型 funct3 子操作与典型用途;再用 Funct7Attrs.encode 推算一个'VE、RTZ、饱和、FP'指令的 funct7 值。

lectures.title: 装载存储指令与数据类型
lectures.topic: 讲解 LD/ST 家族的传输宽度编码、内存设计意图以及 LD/ST 携带的打包数据类型 Bundle。
learning_goals: 理解 LD/ST 用 funct3 表示传输宽度
了解 docs/designs/02.memory.md 的内存模型设想
认识 dataType.scala 中的 U8C4/S8C4/U16C2/S16C2 打包格式
理解 memMicroCode 定义的访存微操作字段
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 dataType.scala,画出 U8C4Input 与 S16C2Input 的字节布局图;然后在 docs/designs/02.memory.md 中找到 LD/ST 传输宽度的设想,写一段说明为何 NPU 需要把 4 个 INT8 打包成一个传输单元。

lectures.title: Scala 汇编器 NpuAssembler
lectures.topic: 讲解 Scala 端汇编器如何用 encR/encI/encS 与命名助手构造 32 位指令字。
learning_goals: 掌握 encR/encI/encS 三个原语的参数与拼接方式
会用 f7/f7Cvt 构造 R 型与 CVT 型的 funct7
理解为何助手返回 Int 且 bit31 为负时要用 toLong & 0xFFFFFFFFL
能调用 vadd/vcvt_s8_f32 等命名助手生成指令字
lectures.practice_task: 在 sbt console 或测试中 import isa.NpuAssembler._,用 vadd 构造一条'VX 宽度、不饱和'的加法指令,打印其 32 位十六进制值,并用 encR + f7 手动拼接同样的指令字验证两者一致。

lectures.title: 组合译码器 InstrDecoder
lectures.topic: 讲解 InstrDecoder 如何把 32 位字组合译码为 DecodedMicroOp,以及非法指令的判定规则。
learning_goals: 理解译码器是组合逻辑、输入 instr 输出 DecodedMicroOp
掌握 DecodedMicroOp 的关键字段(family、valu、mma_keep 等)
理解 illegal 在哪些情况下被置位(保留 opcode、非法 funct3、保留 width 等)
理解 CVT src==dst 也被判非法
lectures.practice_task: 参考 InstrDecoderSpec 的写法,用 NpuAssembler 构造一条合法 vadd 和一条故意填错 funct3 的非法指令,在仿真中分别 poke 进译码器,验证 legal/illegal 输出与 family 字段是否符合预期。

lectures.title: 微操作与控制 Bundle
lectures.topic: 讲解连接译码器、MMALU、VALU 的控制 Bundle:NCoreVALUBundle、NCoreMMALUCtrlBundle 与 VecOp 枚举。
learning_goals: 理解 DecodedMicroOp 如何把译码结果拆成 valu/mma 控制字段
掌握 NCoreVALUBundle 的字段(op、regCls、dtype、sat、round、imm)
掌握 NCoreMMALUCtrlBundle 的 keep/use_accum/busy 三位控制
了解 VecOp ChiselEnum 的取值范围与位宽约束
lectures.practice_task: 在 VALUMicroCode.scala 中列出 VecOp 的所有成员并核对最大值是否仍能用 7 位表示;然后说明 regCls 字段(原 width)为何被改名,以及它在 NCoreVALUBundle 中如何指导写回端口选择。

lectures.title: 多宽度寄存器堆 MultiWidthRegisterBlock
lectures.topic: 讲解 VX/VE/VR 在同一物理字节数组上的别名实现、读写端口布局与冲突规则。
learning_goals: 理解物理存储为 L×K×N/8 字节,VX/VE/VR 三种视图共享
掌握写 VR[i] 原子更新 4 行 VX 的字节级别名机制
理清 vx/ve/vr 各自的读写端口数量与用途
理解 ext 读写端口与 last-writer-wins 的冲突规则
lectures.practice_task: 参考 MultiWidthRegisterSpec,写一个测试场景:先写 VR[0],再分别读 VE[0]、VX[0..3],验证别名关系正确;并解释为何 ext_r_addr 必须被驱动(否则 firtool 报 uninitialized sink)。

lectures.title: 处理单元 PE:累加与 keep 控制
lectures.topic: 讲解 MMPE 处理单元的乘加结构、BasePE 抽象与 keep 控制如何实现流式累加。
learning_goals: 理解 PE 是 NPU 最核心的计算单元,执行 in_a * in_b + 累加
掌握 keep=true 时累加、keep=false 时覆盖的语义
理解 BasePE trait 抽象使 PE 可替换(可注入自定义 PE)
理解 accum_nbits 远大于 nbits 是为了不溢出累加
lectures.practice_task: 参考 PESpec,构造一个 MMPE,连续两拍喂入 (2,3) 与 (4,5) 且第二拍 keep=true,验证累加结果为 2*3+4*5=26;再写一拍 keep=false 验证结果被覆盖为 4*5。

lectures.title: 二维脉动阵列 SystolicArray2D
lectures.topic: 讲解 n×n 脉动阵列如何用水平/垂直移位寄存器把输入向量馈送到每个 PE。
learning_goals: 理解 reg_h/reg_v 两组移位寄存器实现数据脉动传播
掌握 vec_a 从左、vec_b 从顶的输入方向
理解 out_a/out_b 给 n×n 个 PE 提供错拍的数据
理解脉动阵列在多拍内完成矩阵乘的数据复用
lectures.practice_task: 对 n=2 的 SystolicArray2D,手推前 2 拍 vec_a/vec_b 的值如何经移位寄存器到达 4 个 PE 的 out_a/out_b,画出每拍的数据位置图,说明为何对角线 PE 在同一拍拿到同一组输入。

lectures.title: 数据馈送器与收集器
lectures.topic: 讲解 DataFeeder 如何把寄存器向量排布进阵列、DataCollector 如何收集 PE 输出与累加器。
learning_goals: 理解 DataFeeder 把 in_a/in_b/in_accum 适配为阵列输入
掌握 DataCollector 的 accum_in/use_accum/dat_clct 控制
理解收集时机与 keep 信号的配合
了解 DataFeederSpec/DataCollectorSpec 的验证方式
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 DataFeeder 与 DataCollector 的端口,说明 in_accum 如何进入 collector、dat_clct 在哪一拍拉高才会把 PE 输出写入结果,并参考 DataCollectorSpec 设计一个最小用例验证 collector 的输出顺序。

lectures.title: 控制单元 ControlUnit
lectures.topic: 讲解 ControlUnit 如何用一维脉动方式分发控制信号,并用 OR 门汇总 collect 信号。
learning_goals: 理解控制信号也走脉动阵列(reg 一维移位)
掌握 cbus_out 按对角线 i+j 广播给 n×n 个 PE
理解 ORGate 把所有 keep 汇总成 cbus_dat_clct
理解 clct/busy 取自最末级寄存器代表全局完成
lectures.practice_task: 对 n=2 推演 ControlUnit 的 reg 在前 3 拍的内容,标出每拍哪些 cbus_out 会被更新,并解释为何用 OR 汇总 keep 能正确产生 dat_clct(只要任一拍在累加就继续收集)。

lectures.title: MMALU 顶层集成与流式归约
lectures.topic: 讲解 MMALU 如何组装上述组件、为何插入流水寄存器修时序,以及 M×K 流式归约机制。
learning_goals: 理解 MMALU 把 SA+PE+Feeder+Collector+ControlUnit 组装的完整链路
掌握 pipe_a/pipe_b/pipe_ctrl 等流水寄存器为修 200MHz 时序而加
理解延迟从 3n-2 变为 3n-1 的代价
掌握 ctrl.keep=true 实现 M×K 流式归约、每 K 拍输出累积和
lectures.practice_task: 参考 MMALUStreamReduceSpec,设置 ctrl.keep=true 连续喂入超过 K 拍的数据,验证每 K 拍边界输出一个累积 K×K 部分和;再用一句话说明为何流式归约只需一条 keep=true 指令。

lectures.title: VALU 多宽度数据通路
lectures.topic: 讲解 K 通道 VALU 如何对 VX/VE/VR 三种宽度执行算术/逻辑/移动操作并单拍输出。
learning_goals: 理解 VALU(K,N) 三宽度输入与三宽度寄存输出的结构
掌握 ctrl.regCls 选择当前有效的输入/输出宽度
理解算术、逻辑、移动等家族的通路复用
理解 1 拍输出寄存器延迟
lectures.practice_task: 参考 VALUArithSpec,用 K=8 对 VX 宽度构造一条 vadd,把两个含正负值的 INT8 向量相加并验证逐通道结果;再改成 VE 宽度观察位宽变化。

lectures.title: 可编程查找表 LUT 与激活函数
lectures.topic: 讲解 Qfmt 参考表、双 bank 可编程 LUT 与 vlut/vsetlut 的查表激活机制。
learning_goals: 理解 Qfmt 用 SQ1.6/UQ0.8 定点格式生成 exp/recip/tanh/erf 表
掌握双 bank LUT 支持一个 vlut 服务、另一个 vsetlut 预装
理解 vsetlut 只写 VALU 内部 bank 不触碰寄存器堆
了解 VALUActivationSpec 的验证方式
lectures.practice_task: 用 Qfmt.lutExp 计算输入 0 对应的表项值,验证它约为 exp(0)=1 的定点表示;然后说明在 backend 中为何 vsetlut 必须抑制所有 RF 写端口。

lectures.title: FP32/BF16/BF8 浮点运算
lectures.topic: 讲解 fp.scala 中 IEEE754 组合逻辑如何实现 FP32/BF16/BF8 的算术与转换,以及 FTZ/饱和等取舍。
learning_goals: 理解 Tier-2 设计:RNE 默认、FTZ、无 NaN、溢出饱和
掌握 BF8 的 E4M3/E5M2 两种变体
理解 fp.scala 仅组合逻辑、VALU 在外围加 1 拍寄存器
了解 FpRef Scala 参考用于 bit-exact 测试
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 IEEE754 字段常量,手算一个 FP32 值 1.0 的位模式(符号/指数/尾数);然后参考 VALUFP32Spec 设计一个 fadd 用例,并说明 FTZ 对极小输入的影响。

lectures.title: 水平归约与广播
lectures.topic: 讲解 vsum/vrmax/vrmin 水平归约把多通道压缩成 VR 宽度广播结果,以及 vbcast 广播指令。
learning_goals: 理解水平归约结果总是 VR 宽度并广播到 K 通道
掌握归约指令在 funct7 里编码的是输入宽度而非输出宽度
理解 isReduceToVR 在 backend 中的修正作用
掌握 vbcast reg/imm 两种广播方式
lectures.practice_task: 参考 VALUReduceSpec 与 VALUCastSpec,构造一个 vsum.vx 把 8 通道 INT8 归约为一个广播到 VR 的结果;再说明若 backend 不做 isReduceToVR 修正会发生什么写回错误。

lectures.title: NCoreBackend 总体连线
lectures.topic: 讲解 NCoreBackend 如何把译码器、多宽度寄存器堆、MMALU、VALU 连成一个流水线后端。
learning_goals: 理解 NCoreBackend 的四个核心子模块实例化与参数约束(K==mmalu.n)
掌握寄存器堆读写端口到 MMALU/VALU 的分配表
理解 MMALU 结果直写 VR(无截断)、VALU 按宽度写回
理清外部读写端口(ext)与 VR 读取端口的用途
lectures.practice_task: 对照 SimpleBackend 顶部的端口分配注释,画出一张从 io.instr 到 MMALU/VALU 输出再写回寄存器堆的完整连线图,标出 VX 读端口 0..3 各自驱动谁。

lectures.title: 指令分发与写回时序
lectures.topic: 讲解 backend 如何按译码 family 分发、写回端口的使能条件,以及归约/CVT/vsetlut 等边界处理。
learning_goals: 掌握 isVALU 判定覆盖的 9 个 family 与 MMA 分支
理解 vx/ve/vr 写回使能的 regCls 守卫条件
掌握 isNarrowCvtOut/isWideCvtOut/isReduceToVR/isSetLut 的修正逻辑
理解 VALU 1 拍输出寄存器导致的 2 拍写回时序
minimal_modules: CVT/归约/LUT 修正辅助函数
lectures.practice_task: 追踪一条 vcvt_f32_s8(窄输出)与一条 vsum.vx(归约到 VR)在 backend 中的写回路径,解释为何这两条指令需要 isNarrowCvtOut 与 isReduceToVR 特殊处理,否则会写错寄存器类。

lectures.title: 后量化流水线 MMA→vcvt→vfma→vcvt
lectures.topic: 讲解矩阵乘后的 INT8 再量化流水线,以及如何用 Scala java.lang.Float 参考 bit-exact 验证。
learning_goals: 理解 MMA 输出 INT32 累加结果后转 FP32 再缩放再转回 INT8 的流程
掌握 vcvt 在量化链中'宽输出→VR'与'窄输出→VX'的方向
理解 vfma 用于乘缩放因子再加偏置
理解 NCoreBackendQuantSpec 用 Scala 参考 bit-exact 校验
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 NCoreBackendQuantSpec,列出量化链中每条指令的 regCls 与输出宽度;然后手算一个最小输入(INT8 a/b 累加→FP32→×scale→INT8)的期望值,说明参考模型为何选 java.lang.Float。

lectures.title: GEMM + Softmax 端到端教程
lectures.topic: 讲解用归约、可编程 LUT 激活与全量化链实现 transformer 注意力 softmax 的端到端示例。
learning_goals: 理解 softmax 需要的 exp(激活)、归约求和、逐通道除法/缩放
掌握 vlut/vsetlut 在激活函数中的应用
理解数值稳定性与量化误差的处理
理解 NCoreBackendGemmSoftmaxSpec 的端到端验证
lectures.practice_task: 按 docs/tutorials/gemm_softmax_quantization.md 的步骤,用 NpuAssembler 写出一段实现'GEMM→vlut(exp)→vsum→vfma(缩放)'的指令序列伪代码,并指出每步结果落在哪类寄存器(VX/VE/VR)。

lectures.title: FPGA 验证平台 xc7k480t
lectures.topic: 讲解 Kintex-7 xc7k480t 上的 PCIe Gen2×8 + 双 DDR3 + K=32 MMALU 参考平台与时序收敛史。
learning_goals: 理解参考平台的硬件构成(芯片、PCIe、DDR3、时钟域)
掌握 fabric 200MHz / NPU 250MHz 的时钟划分
理解 MMALU 插入流水寄存器修 WNS 的时序收敛过程
了解 build-fpga 的 Vivado 批处理流程
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 FPGA_XC7K480T.md,整理出 WNS=-0.151ns 的违例路径与插入流水寄存器后的改善结果;并解释为何加 1 拍延迟换取时序收敛在 NPU 设计中是合理取舍。

lectures.title: Linux XDMA 内核驱动与 C 工具
lectures.topic: 讲解 Xilinx XDMA 内核驱动(xdma.ko)及其 C 工具(reg_rw/dma_to_device 等)如何访问 NPU。
learning_goals: 理解 /dev/xdma0_* 设备节点与 h2c/c2h/bypass 通道
掌握 reg_rw 读写控制寄存器、dma_to_device/from_device 搬运数据
理解 ctrl_lite + DMA staging 的协议与 C 工具一致
了解 driver/linux 的测试脚本组织
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 driver/linux/README.md 与 reg_rw.c,说明一次完整 MMALU 计算在 C 工具层面需要哪几步(staging A/B/ACCUM→kick→wait→read OUT),并指出 ctrl_lite 控制字在 bypass BAR 中的访问方式。

lectures.title: Python 用户态驱动 chisel_npu_py
lectures.topic: 讲解 chisel_npu_py 如何以 pybind11 边界封装地址、用 numpy 优先的 API 驱动 NPU。
learning_goals: 理解 ChiselNPU.mmalu 的 stage→kick→wait→collect 四步
掌握 XDMADevice 按名字(write_staged/read_staged)寻址operand
理解 CtrlLite 的 start/done/busy 位协议与 wait_done
理解 pybind11 C++ 模块独占所有 fd/地址/transfer 的安全边界
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 npu.py 与 backend.py,写出 ChiselNPU.mmalu(A,B,ACCUM) 的调用序列,并解释为何 Python 侧永远看不到 DDR 地址;再参考 tests/test_loopback.py 说明如何用 mock native 在无硬件时测试驱动。

lectures.title: Chisel 6 仿真测试框架
lectures.topic: 讲解项目用 chisel3.simulator.EphemeralSimulator(而非 chiseltest)的测试方式、共享工具与 ChiselEnum 比较技巧。
learning_goals: 理解 EphemeralSimulator 与 chiseltest 的区别
掌握 testUtil 包(printHelper/widthHelper)的用法
理解 poke enum 有效但 expect enum 无效、需 peek litValue 比较
了解现代 spec 用 NpuAssembler 构造指令字而非直接 poke bundle
lectures.practice_task: 参考 VALUArithSpec 的写法,用 EphemeralSimulator 写一个对 SystolicArray2D(n=2) 的最小测试,peek out_a/out_a 的 litValue 验证移位逻辑;注意不要用 expect 比较 ChiselEnum 字段。

lectures.title: 测试套件组织与 CI 流水线
lectures.topic: 讲解 src/test/scala 下按模块组织的测试套件(MMALU/VALU/ISA/backend),以及 GitHub Actions CI 的运行方式。
learning_goals: 掌握测试目录与源码目录的镜像组织(ALU/ISA/SRAM/backend)
理解单元测试与集成测试(NCoreBackend*Spec)的分层
掌握 tool/test-specific-spec.sh 单测快捷方式
理解 CI 在 fangruil/chisel-dev:amd64 中跑 sbt run + sbt test
lectures.practice_task: 用 tool/test-specific-spec.sh 单独运行 InstrDecoderSpec 与 NCoreBackendQuantSpec,对比单测与集成测试的耗时;然后阅读 actions.yml 说明 CI 在 push 到 main 时执行的确切命令序列。

data.rationale: chisel-npu 是一个用 Chisel 6.7.0 实现的开源 NPU,核心是 NCoreBackend(译码器 + 多宽度寄存器堆 + 脉动矩阵乘 MMALU + 向量 ALU VALU),上层有 RISC-V 风格 32 位 ISA,下层有 Kintex-7 FPGA 验证平台与 Python/Linux 用户态驱动。学习路线据此按"由外到内、由计算单元到系统集成、由 RTL 到平台"的顺序分三层组织:入门层(U1)先让读者跑通项目并掌握贯穿全局的 N/L/K 参数;进阶层(U2-U6)按数据流方向逐层拆解——先 ISA 指令接口,再控制/存储基础(Bundle+寄存器堆),再两个计算单元 MMALU 与 VALU,最后回到 NCoreBackend 看它们如何连线与分发;专家层(U7-U9)上升到端到端量化流水线、FPGA 平台与驱动、以及测试与 CI。单元划分对应物理边界(ISA / 存储 / 矩阵引擎 / 向量引擎 / 集成 / 流水线 / 平台 / 测试),每篇讲义只解决一个问题并附一个可在容器内验证的代码实践,依赖关系保证读者随时知道每个模块的前置知识来自哪里。

理解收集时机与 keep 信号的配合

理解 ORGate 把所有 keep 汇总成 cbus_dat_clct

lectures.title: VALU 多宽度数据通路
lectures.topic: 讲解 K 通道 VALU 如何对 VX/VE/VR 三种宽度执行算术/逻辑/移动操作并单拍输出。

理解 1 拍输出寄存器延迟

了解 VALUActivationSpec 的验证方式
